$comment: What the server keeps and derives from real-time data (docs/DESIGN.md#retention-and-statistics). Read by apps/server/src/jobs/.
$retentionDays: Raw real-time data (GTFS-RT positions, AIS fixes: database rows and hourly files) is deleted after this many days. Decided (docs/DESIGN.md#decisions 'Retention'). Observed stop times, statistics, service changes, alerts and GTFS feeds are kept indefinitely.
$observed: Observed stop times from recorded positions (packages/transit-core/src/rt/observed.ts). Guesses; see regions/metro-vancouver/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #30.
$stats: Daily per-route statistics (packages/transit-core/src/rt/stats.ts). onTimeS is decided (docs/DESIGN.md#decisions 'Statistics': 1 min early to 3 min late at timepoints). maxPrecisionS, minTripCoverage, bunchingShare and the bands are guesses; see regions/metro-vancouver/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #30. Bands are seconds since the service day's start, by a trip's first scheduled departure.
$afterServiceDayH: A service date's observed stop times and statistics are computed once this many hours after its start (the service day runs past midnight: the last trips end around 02:00-03:00).
$dataBuildAt: Local time of the daily transit data build on the server (GTFS static from gtfs-static.translink.ca, which isn't part of the Open API budget).
